verdict.rationale: USCIS publishes the delegation form and roles. Form G-28 must be filed by an attorney or accredited representative to establish eligibility to represent a client. Representatives can file on a client's behalf and submit subsequent G-28s through a dedicated representative online account. The evidence does not say what a representative may not do, or which signatures must remain the applicant's own. missing for 10: published limits on the representative's scope, rules on which signatures stay personal to the applicant, detail on roles beyond attorney/accredited representative, independent corroboration
